calculation.price_identity: token1_per_token0 = (sqrtPriceX96 / 2^96)^2 because every scoped token has 6 decimals

same_asset_usdce_wrap_then_sell.route: wrap 1 USDC.e into 1 pUSD then sell pUSD for USDC.e

unclosed_native_usdc_buy_then_unwrap.route: buy pUSD with native USDC then unwrap pUSD into USDC.e

decision.next_trigger: reopen only after a material lower-fee same-asset pUSD-USDC.e route appears or a source-bound marginal deviation exceeds the exact route fee plus conservative gas and finite-size price impact
decision.reason: the only exact 1-to-1 same-asset loop loses 22.4388 bips at the marginal price after the 30-bip pool fee, while the native-USDC route already loses 0.3328 bips after its 1-bip fee and settles into different USDC.e before price impact gas and USDC basis

mechanism.name: polymarket_pusd_external_wrap_unwrap_parity
mechanism.onchain_identity: Polymarket's CollateralOnramp wraps USDC.e to pUSD 1-to-1 and CollateralOfframp unwraps pUSD to USDC.e 1-to-1
mechanism.purpose: test a market-direction-independent external parity loop before any quote account wallet or transaction work

safety_and_limits: The marginal calculation deliberately ignores finite-size price impact and gas, so a negative result is already terminal for the captured state.
The native-USDC route is not a closed same-asset payoff because the official unwrap returns USDC.e; USDC-to-USDC.e basis and conversion costs can only worsen the captured negative marginal result.
DEX Screener was used only to discover pool addresses; its displayed prices liquidity and volume are not execution evidence.
The first unpinned latest-state RPC batch is excluded from the decision; the canonical calculation uses only the later block-pinned batch.
No Quoter call or finite-size book was requested because both candidate directions failed the cheaper optimistic marginal fee gate.
The result is a point-in-time terminal rejection, not evidence that future dislocations cannot occur.
